title: Implementar runner CI narrow-browser para detalle PIN de Live
mission: Implement a deterministic GitHub Actions/Playwright runner for the published Prometeo Live page at a narrow viewport so generic workers can launch the existing PIN-lineage browser verification through CI. The runner must expand a contended or recovered worker, assert compact generation/owner/collision/recovery evidence, check page overflow and navigation/liveness behavior, and persist bounded artifacts without changing product state.
definition_of_done: Add a controllable narrow-viewport JavaScript-browser test against the published Live UI.
Expand a contended or recovered worker and assert readable generation, owner, collision and recovery evidence.
Assert no page-wide horizontal overflow and readable text at the tested viewport.
Exercise tabs/swipe-equivalent navigation available to automation and verify the 6m/10m liveness presentation remains present/consistent.
Persist machine-readable results and screenshots or equivalent rendered evidence through a bounded CI workflow.
Do not infer Human Accepted or change Current, Served or production /w authority.
